_about: Election dates for the civic assistant, covering federal, state, county, school district, and city races. build_calendars.py turns this into an Arizona calendar (statewide items only) plus one calendar per city. applies_to is 'all' (everyone in Arizona), or a list of city keys (like 'tempe') and county keys (like 'county:maricopa'). status is 'confirmed' (an official source states it), 'computed' (worked out from Arizona's 29-day and 11-day rules), or 'confirm' (expected but not yet published; check before testers see it). past: true elections are kept for demo mode and are not written to the calendars.

_rules.registration_deadline: Midnight on the 29th day before the election (azsos.gov)
_rules.early_ballot_request_deadline: 5 p.m. on the 11th day before the election (azsos.gov)
_rules.early_voting_starts: 27th day before the election; confirm with the county for each election
_rules.primaries: Arizona voters registered as independent or with no party can choose one party's ballot in the state primary. They cannot vote in the presidential preference election.

elections.name: Maricopa County jurisdictional election

races.office: School district bond and budget override measures, if any districts call them
City bond or charter measures, if any city calls them

elections.notes: Maricopa County held a November election in 2025 for school district bonds and overrides and a few city measures. Districts decide by summer whether to put a measure on the November 2027 ballot, so this election may or may not reach every voter. It is the nearest possible election for testers. Watch the county elections site and school district board agendas from June 2027. Other counties may hold their own November 2027 elections for school measures; check the county elections office.

elections.name: Arizona presidential preference election

races.office: Party presidential nominee (only for voters registered with a participating party)

elections.notes: Independents cannot vote in this election. Registration deadline matters twice here: to vote at all, and to switch parties if someone wants to take part. Confirm the date with azsos.gov.

elections.notes: Tempe's clerk page is old enough that the date should be rechecked before launch.

elections.name: Arizona primary election

races.office: Party nominees for U.S. Senate and all nine U.S. House seats
Party nominees for all 90 state legislature seats and three Corporation Commission seats
Party nominees for county offices in every county (supervisors, recorder, sheriff, county attorney, assessor, treasurer, school superintendent)
Mesa city primary (mayor and Districts 1, 2 and 3)

elections.notes: The date is not set. The 2026 primary was July 21 after a one-time change, and bills in the legislature would put future primaries in late July. The builder skips this election until a date is filled in.

elections.name: General election
elections.source: Federal law sets the general election on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November.
